long_biography.plain_text:
Friesacher grew up in an Anif hospitality and farming family, then raced in German Formula Three and international Formula 3000 during the 1990s. After leaving competition, he opened a truck stop near Salzburg and developed the idea into automated discount filling stations on Hofer supermarket sites. A network that began with one location ultimately expanded across Austria.

The fuel business produced Friesacher’s defining commercial breakthrough. He sold 66 discount stations to OMV and later exited his remaining truck-stop portfolio, freeing attention for other businesses. His holding structure grew across property and investments, while his 2018 acquisition of Gmundner Keramik added a centuries-old Austrian manufacturer. Friesacher has since backed retail expansion and new creative collaborations around the craft brand.
